name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 17, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-k, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of April 3, 2018.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
i.
February Treasury & Investment Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Consideration of a Resolution Adopting a Project List for FY 18-19 Funded By SB 1, the Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017
RES 2018-09 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA CALIFORNIA ADOPTING A LIST OF PROJECTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19 FUNDED BY SB 1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017.
ACTION: It is recommended that City Council:
1.
Adopt a Resolution approving the Project List for FY 2018-2019 funded by SB 1, the Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017; and
2.
Authorize the City Manager or his designee to complete, sign, and submit all required documentation for receipt of Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) funds to the appropriate State and other agencies.
Item #7j
k.
Approve a Memorandum of Agreement regarding the Administration and Cost Sharing for Implementing the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program (CIMP) and Enhanced Watershed Management Plan (EWMP) for the Dominguez Channel Watershed Management Area
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council:
1.
Approve a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) regarding the administration and cost sharing for implementing the Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program (CIMP) and Enhanced Watershed Management Plan (EWMP) for the Dominguez Channel Watershed Management Area;
2.
Authorize the Mayor to sign the MOA; and
3.
Approve Lomita's estimated share of the funding amount shown in Exhibit C of the MOA, totaling $432,026 for fiscal years 2018-2019 through 2022-2023.
Item #7k
8.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, May 1, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Dated this 13th Day of April 2018
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
